script.cover_1: Why does your manager ask for updates every hour?
script.payoff: Fixed update times cut the pings and still keep the manager informed.
script.caption: Fixed check-ins keep a manager informed and a junior working. Send this to the colleague who gets pinged all day.
script.request: A manager wants to know how the work is going.
script.pushy: Any update? Why does nobody tell me anything?
script.professional: A short update at 1 pm and 4 pm is enough. No pings between.
script.why: It sets fixed check-in times, so the junior can focus in between.
script.reply_me: Can we fix update times, 1 pm and 4 pm? Then I can work without breaks.
